mail.admin_account_moved.body.defaultMessage:
An account that the moderators of {instance} limit moved to another account. The account it moved to does not get the limit.

Open your notifications to review it:

{url}

You get this email because you chose to get moderator notifications by email. You can turn it off in your preferences.
mail.admin_account_moved.body.description: Plain-text body of the email to a moderator about an account with a limit that moved to another account. It never names the accounts. {instance} is the server's display name, or its domain name when it has none; {url} the link to the notifications (keep it on its own line).

mail.admin_account_moved.subject.defaultMessage: An account limited on {instance} moved to another account
mail.admin_account_moved.subject.description: Subject of the email to a moderator who chose to get moderator notifications by email: an account that the moderators limit moved to another account. {instance} is the server's display name, or its domain name when it has none.

You get this email because you chose to get moderator notifications by email. You can turn it off in your preferences.

mail.password_changed.body.defaultMessage:
The password of your account on {instance} was changed, and your other sessions and apps were signed out.

If you did not change it, someone else may know your password. Set a new one at once:

{url}

This email was sent by {host}.
mail.password_changed.body.description: Plain-text body of the email that tells a user their password was changed. {instance} is the server's display name, or its domain name when it has none; {host} the server's domain name, {url} the page that asks for a password reset link (keep it on its own line).

mail.password_changed.subject.description: Subject of the email that tells a user their password was changed. {instance} is the server's display name, or its domain name when it has none.

mail.password_removed.body.defaultMessage:
The password of your account on {instance} was removed, and your other sessions and apps were signed out. From now on you sign in with your passkeys.

If you did not remove it, someone else may be signed in to your account. Set a new password at once:

{url}

This email was sent by {host}.
mail.password_removed.body.description: Plain-text body of the email that tells a user their password was removed, so that only their passkeys sign in. {instance} is the server's display name, or its domain name when it has none; {host} the server's domain name, {url} the page that asks for a password reset link, which sets a new password (keep it on its own line).

mail.password_removed.subject.description: Subject of the email that tells a user their password was removed, so that only their passkeys sign in. {instance} is the server's display name, or its domain name when it has none.

mail.password_reset.body.defaultMessage:
Someone asked to reset the password of your account on {instance}.

Open this link to set a new password:

{url}

{minutes, plural, one {The link works for # minute, once.} other {The link works for # minutes, once.}} If you did not ask for it at {host}, ignore this email; your password stays as it is.
mail.password_reset.body.description: Plain-text body of the email with a password reset link. {instance} is the server's display name, or its domain name when it has none; {host} the server's domain name, {url} the reset link (keep it on its own line), {minutes} how long the link works.

mail.password_reset.subject.description: Subject of the email with a password reset link. {instance} is the server's display name, or its domain name when it has none.

mail.supporter_payment_failed.body.defaultMessage:
A payment for your supporter plan “{plan}” on {instance} failed.

You keep the plan's benefits until {endsAt} (UTC). If no payment succeeds by then, they end. Update your payment method here:

{url}

You get this email because you subscribe to a supporter plan on {instance}.
mail.supporter_payment_failed.body.description: Plain-text body of the email to a subscriber whose payment for a supporter plan failed. {instance} is the server's display name, or its domain name when it has none; {plan} the plan's name, written by the administrators; {endsAt} the end of the grace period as YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM in UTC; {url} the link to the supporter page of the web client (keep it on its own line).

mail.supporter_payment_failed.subject.defaultMessage: A payment for your supporter plan on {instance} failed
mail.supporter_payment_failed.subject.description: Subject of the email to a subscriber whose payment for a supporter plan failed. {instance} is the server's display name, or its domain name when it has none.

mail.supporter_plan_retired.body.defaultMessage:
The administrators of {instance} retired the supporter plan “{plan}” that you subscribe to.

Your subscription is canceled and will not renew. You keep the plan's benefits until the end of the period you paid for, unless a payment is overdue.

Open your notifications:

{url}

You get this email because you subscribe to a supporter plan on {instance}.
mail.supporter_plan_retired.body.description: Plain-text body of the email to a subscriber whose supporter plan the administrators retired. {instance} is the server's display name, or its domain name when it has none; {plan} the plan's name, written by the administrators; {url} the link to the notifications (keep it on its own line).

mail.supporter_plan_retired.subject.defaultMessage: Your supporter plan on {instance} was retired
mail.supporter_plan_retired.subject.description: Subject of the email to a subscriber whose supporter plan the administrators retired. {instance} is the server's display name, or its domain name when it has none.

mail.supporter_subscription_ended.body.description: Plain-text body of the email to a subscriber whose supporter subscription ended. {instance} is the server's display name, or its domain name when it has none; {plan} the plan's name, written by the administrators; {reason} the reason code (not shown), each branch saying why; {url} the link to the notifications (keep it on its own line).

mail.supporter_subscription_ended.subjec.description: Subject of the email to a subscriber whose supporter subscription ended: a payment kept failing, a payment was refunded, the plan was retired, or it was canceled. {instance} is the server's display name, or its domain name when it has none.
